args.command:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="nothingness_shots"
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${TAG}"
mkdir -p "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share"
rm -f "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" || true
[ -p "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" ] || { rm -f "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; mkfifo "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; }
nohup sleep infinity > "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" 2>/dev/null &
HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" XDG_DATA_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share" \
  nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" > "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>&1 &

# Wait for VM service.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if DRIVE_TARGET=linux DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME" \
      .claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect >/tmp/drive_inspect_tmp.json 2>/tmp/drive_inspect_tmp.err; then
    echo "VM ready";
    break;
  fi
  sleep 2;
done

# Drive scenario.
MEDIA_DIR="/opt/nothingness/media"
TRACK="$MEDIA_DIR/01-undercover-49.opus"

export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME"

.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py nav "$MEDIA_DIR" >/dev/null
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py play "$TRACK" >/dev/null

# Ensure any initial UI settles.
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect >/dev/null || true

.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot before_now_playing_row >/dev/null

# Activate the conditional glyph.
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tap void-crumb-jump-to-playing >/dev/null || true
# Give time for scroll animation.
sleep 1
.\claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py shoot after_now_playing_row >/dev/null

ls -ლა .tmp/agent_shots | grep -E "before_now_playing_row|after_now_playing_row" || true
